column2: DANGER Grain Bin Roof Manhole Sign – Walking Down Grain Can Bury You – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Walking Down Grain Can Bury You. This DANGER Grain Bin Roof Manhole sign from CGAP Safety reads: GRAIN BIN ROOF MANHOLE / NEVER WALK DOWN GRAIN / FLOWING GRAIN CAN BURY YOU / LOCK OUT ALL UNLOADING / BEFORE ANY BIN ENTRY. Written for commercial grain elevators, farm bin sites, ag co-ops and feed mills.

Why this sign matters

Walking on grain to make it flow while unloading equipment runs pulls the worker into the flowing column and buries him in seconds.

Where to post it

Roof manhole and top entry hatch.

Who orders it

Elevator superintendents, farm grain managers, co-op safety coordinators.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.272(g)(1)(ii); 1910.272(g)(1)(iv). A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.
